name: M2.5 x 10mm Full Thread Socket Cap Head Screws (DIN 912) - High Tensile Steel (12.9)
description: Metric Socket Cap Head Screws feature an internal socket drive that is designed for use with a Hex Key, otherwise known as an Allen Key. With the terms ‘socket’ and ‘allen’ being so interchangeable within engineering, this explains why these fasteners are also commonly referred to as Allen Key Bolts or Socket Screws. Accu's range of Cap Screws are manufactured in accordance with industry standards, such as DIN 912 and ISO 4762. Screws within this range are available in either a fully threaded or partially threaded form, with the latter featuring an unthreaded portion below the head of the screw. The distinction of whether the screw is fully threaded or not is detailed in each individual product specification. If a larger unthreaded portion is required, Accu's range of Socket Shoulder Screws range may be more suitable, depending upon your application. Metric Cap Head Captive Screws A number of Accu's Metric & Imperial Socket Cap Screws are also available to be modified to feature a precisely machined unthreaded section, affording a retaining capability. These specialised Captive Screws are used to provide a secure fixture and help to prevent damage or loss of screws in a housing assembly. Accu's range of Cap Head Captive Screws are designed to aid compliance with EU Safety Directives. Vented Socket Screws Accu can also offer Vented Cap Screws, which are a specially modified variant of this component that allow the release of gases and pressure through a bore that runs through the centre of the screw. Materials Socket Cap Screws within this range are available in a wide selection of materials, including metals ranging from A2, A4, A4-80, Duplex and Bumax Stainless Steel, 12.9 High Tensile Steel, Aluminium and Titanium. Plastic variants are also available as standard in Nylon, Polycarbonate, Reny and PEEK Thermoplastic.Optimise your Metric Socket Cap Head Screws against vibrations and loosening with our pre-applied thread-locking patches, from essential AccuLock Threadlocker, robust Anu-Lok 180 through to our high performance Precote 80. Personalise your components with AccuBlack chemical blackening to reduce reflections and add a premium finish aesthetic finish. Metric Cap Head Screws Metric Socket Cap Screws are available from Accu in sizes M1.4 to M30, and lengths of between 2mm and 300mm. Both partially threaded and fully threaded varieties are available. Imperial Cap Head Screws Imperial Socket Cap Head Screws are supplied in sizes between #0 (No. 0) and ¾ inches. Lengths of between 3/32 inch and 5.½ inches are available as standard, and are manufactured in both fully and partially threaded varieties. Minimum Thread Length In accordance with DIN standards, Accu's Socket Cap Screws are manufactured to a minimum specified thread length - this measurement can be found within each individual product page. If this dimension is critical to your application, please contact us before placing your order.

name: M3 x 5mm Full Thread Socket Cap Head Screws (DIN 912) - High Tensile Steel (12.9)
description: Metric Socket Cap Head Screws feature an internal socket drive that is designed for use with a Hex Key, otherwise known as an Allen Key. With the terms ‘socket’ and ‘allen’ being so interchangeable within engineering, this explains why these fasteners are also commonly referred to as Allen Key Bolts or Socket Screws. Accu's range of Cap Screws are manufactured in accordance with industry standards, such as DIN 912 and ISO 4762. Screws within this range are available in either a fully threaded or partially threaded form, with the latter featuring an unthreaded portion below the head of the screw. The distinction of whether the screw is fully threaded or not is detailed in each individual product specification. If a larger unthreaded portion is required, Accu's range of Socket Shoulder Screws range may be more suitable, depending upon your application. Metric Cap Head Captive Screws A number of Accu's Metric & Imperial Socket Cap Screws are also available to be modified to feature a precisely machined unthreaded section, affording a retaining capability. These specialised Captive Screws are used to provide a secure fixture and help to prevent damage or loss of screws in a housing assembly. Accu's range of Cap Head Captive Screws are designed to aid compliance with EU Safety Directives. Vented Socket Screws Accu can also offer Vented Cap Screws, which are a specially modified variant of this component that allow the release of gases and pressure through a bore that runs through the centre of the screw. Materials Socket Cap Screws within this range are available in a wide selection of materials, including metals ranging from A2, A4, A4-80, Duplex and Bumax Stainless Steel, 12.9 High Tensile Steel, Aluminium and Titanium. Plastic variants are also available as standard in Nylon, Polycarbonate, Reny and PEEK Thermoplastic.Optimise your Metric Socket Cap Head Screws against vibrations and loosening with our pre-applied thread-locking patches, from essential AccuLock Threadlocker, robust Anu-Lok 180 through to our high performance Precote 80. Personalise your components with AccuBlack chemical blackening to reduce reflections and add a premium finish aesthetic finish. Metric Cap Head Screws Metric Socket Cap Screws are available from Accu in sizes M1.4 to M30, and lengths of between 2mm and 300mm. Both partially threaded and fully threaded varieties are available. Imperial Cap Head Screws Imperial Socket Cap Head Screws are supplied in sizes between #0 (No. 0) and ¾ inches. Lengths of between 3/32 inch and 5.½ inches are available as standard, and are manufactured in both fully and partially threaded varieties. Minimum Thread Length In accordance with DIN standards, Accu's Socket Cap Screws are manufactured to a minimum specified thread length - this measurement can be found within each individual product page. If this dimension is critical to your application, please contact us before placing your order.
